evals.prompt: Use my design philosophy to design the UI for a small macOS menu-bar app that shows our team's on-call schedule and lets me hand over a shift. There's no existing code yet; it's for about 40 SREs.
Redesign our internal incident metrics dashboard (in ./dashboard) using my design philosophy. It's shown on a TV in the ops room and on laptops. Brand guide is in ./brand/guide.md.
can you apply my design philosophy to the onboarding flow of our mobile banking app? users are older customers switching from branches. keep it accessible

pairs.title: On call · main panel
pairs.caption: With: a shift strip above the rotation list. Without: a Now/Schedule tab bar and a next-shifts section.

pairs.title: Composing a handover
pairs.caption: With: an eight-hour range and availability on each candidate. Without: a thirteen-hour range and a disclosure for less suitable candidates.

pairs.title: Waiting for acceptance
pairs.caption: With: an outlined, hatched segment marked PR?. Without: a striped segment labelled Priya?. Both say the shift remains yours.

pairs.title: Offline · cached schedule
pairs.caption: With: cached-data age sits in the footer, with a connection explanation below Hand over. Without: an offline notice follows the next-shifts section. Both disable handover.

pairs.title: Not on call
pairs.caption: With: the next shift appears in the main answer. Without: a separate next-shifts section follows the rotation list.

pairs.title: Handover accepted
pairs.caption: With: the accepted interval remains on the multi-day strip. Without: the remainder is labelled with Priya's name on the shift bar.

pairs.title: Handover declined
pairs.caption: With: the reply appears below the shift strip as plain text. Without: the reply has a tinted notice inside the current-shift panel.

pairs.title: Incoming handover request
pairs.caption: With: the request appears before your own shift. Without: the request replaces the main you-panel and includes a rota check.

pairs.title: Handover could not be sent
pairs.caption: Only in with: an in-place send failure keeps the handover form and states that nothing changed.

pairs.title: Coverage gap · main panel
pairs.caption: Only in with: a gap warning appears in the main panel. Without has gap information in its separate Schedule view.

pairs.title: First sync
pairs.caption: Only in with: a first-sync spinner and a connecting message in an otherwise empty panel.

pairs.title: Not connected · first run
pairs.caption: Only in with: a first-run sign-in state before a schedule is connected.

pairs.title: Weekly schedule
pairs.caption: Only in without: a dedicated Schedule tab with a seven-day rotation view and a named gap.

pairs.title: TV · Live · SEV1, no commander
pairs.caption: With: the missing commander sits in the SEV1 row and the on-call band. Without: it is called out in a banner and an on-call card; the SEV1 is repeated in the list.

pairs.title: TV · Data stale
pairs.caption: With: an amber freshness header retains the incident list. Without: an inverse warning replaces the status banner and dims the data. Fixture ages differ (about six versus seven minutes).

pairs.title: TV · All clear
pairs.caption: With: zero-open wording leads into resolved history. Without: an all-clear banner includes days since the last SEV1. The runs invented different history and budget values.

pairs.title: TV · Loading
pairs.caption: With: row-shaped placeholders reserve the list and chart areas. Without: loading messages occupy the dashboard's existing panels.

pairs.title: TV · Rota source failed
pairs.caption: Only in with: the rota source fails while incident and metric data remain live; this is not the whole-feed failure on the other run.

pairs.title: TV · Surge · twelve open incidents
pairs.caption: Only in with: twelve open incidents; TV names the rows that cannot fit, while laptop can scroll.

pairs.title: TV · SEV1 · commander assigned
pairs.caption: Only in without: Ana L. is assigned as incident commander in the live SEV1 state.

pairs.title: TV · SEV2 only
pairs.caption: Only in without: the SEV1 has resolved and the headline changes to the remaining SEV2 incidents.

pairs.title: TV · Entire feed down
pairs.caption: Only in without: the entire incident feed is unavailable; this differs from losing just the rota source.

pairs.title: TV · original (before)
pairs.caption: Both: the same unmodified original dashboard. This is shared context, not a with/without design result. The original has no dark theme.

pairs.title: Welcome · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: setup requirements and a Start button share the welcome screen. Without: two account-status choices lead to a separate preparation screen.

pairs.title: Account details · errors · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: errors concern the long card number and date of birth. Without: errors concern date of birth, sort code and account number. Both use a summary plus field errors.

pairs.title: Enter the texted code · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: the code input and Continue come before a preview with blank code digits. Without: a preview containing 482 913 comes before the input.

pairs.title: Done · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: balance and last money in follow the setup confirmation. Without: a balance panel precedes reminders that card and branch banking remain available.

pairs.title: Account details · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: long card number and date of birth, plus an alternate account-number route. Without: date of birth, sort code and account number are the default route.

pairs.title: Account not found · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: the no-match message stays on the details form. Without: no match has its own result screen. Both represent the same failed account lookup.

pairs.title: Text code · wrong · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: an inline wrong-code message leaves the field high on the page. Without: a summary precedes the preview and code field. Both name the remaining tries.

pairs.title: Text code · delivery help · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: delivery help expands within the code screen, with a new-code notice. Without: a separate help screen offers resend, a voice call and changed-number guidance.

pairs.title: Choose a passcode · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: passcode and confirmation are on one screen. Without: confirmation is a separate step.

pairs.title: Passcode · easy to guess · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: the two-field form rejects a sequential passcode. Without: an error summary and message appear on the first passcode screen.

pairs.title: Optional biometrics · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: face or fingerprint includes a warning about other people enrolled on the phone. Without: fingerprint is offered alongside a full-size passcode-only option.

pairs.title: Account details · help sheet · 390 px
pairs.caption: With: help explains the card-number route and its alternative. Without: help explains where to find sort code and account number, with a card illustration.

pairs.title: Alternative · no card · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in with: an explicit alternate identification route. Without already uses sort code and account number by default (see Account details).

pairs.title: Text code expired · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in with: an expired-code message and a new-code action; this differs from the other run's session-timeout dialog.

pairs.title: Text code · attempt limit · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in with: a dedicated attempt-limit state replaces the code form.

pairs.title: Final setup · working · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in with: named connection tasks after biometrics. Without's checking states happen earlier, before text-code verification.

pairs.title: Final setup · slow · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in with: a delayed final-setup state keeps the connection tasks and adds reassurance.

pairs.title: Final setup · failed · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in with: a final-setup failure explains that the account has not changed and offers retry.

pairs.title: Before you start · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in without: a dedicated preparation screen. With puts requirements on its welcome screen.

pairs.title: New customer guidance · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in without: people without an existing account are directed to assisted account opening.

pairs.title: Identity check · working · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in without: named identity-check tasks before the text-code step; with moves directly from valid details to code.

pairs.title: Identity check · slow · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in without: the identity check explains a longer-than-usual wait.

pairs.title: Identity check · very slow · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in without: an extended identity-check delay offers a way to stop and keep the entered details.

pairs.title: Identity check · failed · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in without: a failure before text verification says no money moved and offers retry.

pairs.title: Session timeout warning · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in without: a modal offers more time or stopping. With deliberately has no screen timeout.

pairs.title: Confirm passcode · separate step · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in without: passcode confirmation has its own screen. With combines both fields (see Choose a passcode).

pairs.title: Confirm passcode · mismatch · 390 px
pairs.caption: Without: mismatch is on the separate confirmation step. With also validates mismatches, on its combined form; captured via that form here.

pairs.title: Standalone safety advice · 390 px
pairs.caption: Only in without: a separate scam-advice acknowledgement. With places scam advice alongside text-code verification.
